name: Saiki (Ōita, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Saiki city emblem in green, red and light blue: green, red and light blue curved strokes, like a wave.
history: Municipal flag of Saiki, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 March 2005.
